## Trooper's Skate 3 Recomp Launcher v3.1.2

A bug-fix and stability patch release based on a full codebase audit. Everything from [v3.1.1](https://github.com/Trooper-code/Troopers-Skate-3-Recomp-Launcher/releases/tag/v3.1.1) is unchanged.

### 🐛 Fixed

- **Recomp zip cleanup race:** Downloading and installing a Skate 3 Recomp update no longer deletes the temporary `.zip` file before the background installer finishes reading it. Choosing **Install from a zip…** never deletes your own `.zip` file.
- **Settings backup restore guards:** Restoring a settings backup now checks if Skate 3 is running first, uses the launcher's dark confirmation and error dialogs, and catches file I/O errors instead of crashing.
- **Global crash log & background worker safety:** Unhandled exceptions are now written to a crash log so failures are easier to diagnose. Background tasks for game file verification, quick checks, and driver/known-issue checks also catch errors cleanly and reset their busy state instead of getting stuck or crashing.
- **Zip handle leak on corrupt archives:** Opening a broken or non-zip file during recomp installs, mod installs, or save backup operations now closes the file handle immediately if the archive fails to open.
- **Mod packager protected-file guard:** Packaging a mod now skips protected game executables (like `default.xex` and `EAWebkit.xex`) in the top-level mod folder as well as subfolders.
- **Discord Rich Presence pipe errors:** Failed or broken Discord pipe connections are now disposed and handled quietly instead of leaking pipe handles or throwing unhandled exceptions.
- **Windows GPU dropdown spurious save:** Opening the Launcher page or changing your game folder no longer triggers an unintended Windows GPU preference write when the dropdown loads its current value.
- **Controller navigation null guard:** Moving focus with a controller when no page is active is now safely ignored instead of throwing a null-reference error.

### Install

1. Download `TroopersSkate3Launcher-v3.1.2-win.zip` below.
2. Extract `Trooper's Skate 3 Recomp Launcher.exe` into your Skate 3 Recomp folder, next to `skate3.exe` (replace the old one).
3. Run it. It needs Windows 10 or 11, which already includes the .NET Framework it uses.

Your settings, profiles, history, save backups and launcher options are all kept.

The exe isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**. This release was built by GitHub Actions directly from the source in this repo.

*Unofficial and not affiliated with the Skate 3 Recomp developers or EA. No game files are included.*
